title: Asahina Mafuyu — Memories Of Warm Affection〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Welcome, Mafuyu.
How is your fever...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Better. It broke the following day...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I wrote them for the song Kanade composed the other day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's still a work in progress, so I'm still not entirely sure about some parts of it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I won't know if they're good or not even if I sang them, so I was wondering if you could, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You want me to sing these...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay.
But can I have some time to practice...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh...
Mafuyu, do I just sing this as is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, but something about it doesn't feel right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If I sing it as is, it'll go like...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is this what you were trying to express?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll try changing the words for that part...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This matches the warmth that I felt when I heard Kanade's song...)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Can you stay and hold my hand...?
Until I fall asleep...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. My, aren't we full of demands today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Of course, dear. Now, lie down for me, and take my hand...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (My chest still tightens up when I remind myself of that...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(That warmth...
I don't ever want to forget it...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I hope I won't forget about what I felt that time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll remember too, so you'll never forget.
